text.title: Whoever protects the honor of his brother in his absence, Allah will protect his face from the Fire on the Day of Judgment
text.text: Abu ad-Dardā’ (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Whoever protects the honor of his brother in his absence, Allah will protect his face from the Fire on the Day of Judgment."
text.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) informs that if a Muslim defends the honour of his fellow Muslim in his absence by preventing others from backbiting him, Allah will protect him from the punishment on the Day of Judgment.
text.benefits:
It is prohibited to backbite or slander Muslims.
Recompense is of the same type as one's deeds. So, whoever defends the honor of his fellow Muslim, Allah will defend him against the Fire.
Islam is a religion of fraternity and mutual support among its adherents.

arabic.title: من رد عن عرض أخيه رد الله عن وجهه النار يوم القيامة
arabic.text: عن أبي الدرداء رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «مَنْ رَدَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ أَخِيهِ رَدَّ اللهُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ النَّارَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ».
arabic.explanation: يُخْبِرُ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أنَّ مَن دافَعَ عن عِرْضِ أخيه المسلم في غَيْبته بمنع ذَمِّهِ أو الإساءة إليه، فإنَّ اللهَ يَرُدُّ عنه العذابَ يومَ القيامة.
arabic.benefits:
النهي عن الكلام في أعراض المسلمين.
الجزاء من جنس العمل، فمن رَدَّ عن عِرض أخيه ردَّ الله عنه النار.
الإسلام دين التآخي والتناصُر بين أهله.
